description: Request cancellation of a daemon-owned run; success is returned only after the control API acknowledges the durable command. The same call holds the run's next message (claudexor_next_message) that is not accepted yet, also after the run ended; an already accepted successor fails next_message_dispatched with its job handle and keeps running. If that hold cannot be saved, the call fails next_message_hold_failed (retryable) after any cancel was applied; the next message is still not sent, and a retried cancel records the hold.

runId.description: Daemon run id (from a run tool's runId trailer or claudexor_runs).

name: claudexor_run_cancel
